title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You'll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You'll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix's collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil's legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you'll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that's just the beginning - here's what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you're well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Analista Marketing Pl
description:
Estamos contratando: Analista de Marketing Pleno

Na Apsen Farmacêutica, acreditamos que o marketing é um elo entre ciência, estratégia e propósito. Cada iniciativa reflete nosso compromisso em promover conhecimento, inovação e qualidade de vida.

  • Atender solicitações e respondendo quaisquer dúvidas da força de vendas sobre materiais promocionais, produtos e investimentos promocionais, a fim de atender as necessidades do cliente interno;
  • Desenvolver, junto com a gerencia, o relacionamento com médicos líderes de opinião, visando a difusão dos produtos e conceitos dentro da classe médica;
  • Reportar informações sobre a estratégia do produto e da linha, para a equipe de treinamento da força de vendas, a fim de manter a atualização da equipe de vendas;

  • Conhecimento em SAP;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, com 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia de home office por semana.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Matemática, Estatística, Física ou áreas relacionadas.

title: Técnico de Manutenção Predial
description:
RESUMO DO TRABALHO:

Realiza tarefas técnicas, elétricas e mecânicas, incluindo instalação, reparo, manutenção preventiva, solução de problemas e melhorias de processos em instalações existentes e futuras. Além disso, o técnico de manutenção trabalhará na conservação das áreas externas, áreas comuns e áreas de produção para manter o padrão da empresa de ambientes limpos e seguros.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Trabalhar com o Gerente de Manutenção para desenvolver cronogramas padrão de manutenção preventiva.

• Operar, reparar e manter equipamentos de produção, equipamentos de movimentação de materiais, sistemas elétricos e mecânicos, incluindo, mas não limitado a sistemas e equipamentos de sprinklers contra incêndio.

• Substituir peças defeituosas como engrenagens, embreagens, buchas, eixos, rolamentos, solenóides, válvulas, bombas, controles de direção, etc.

• Executar manutenção de rotina em todas as máquinas da planta e demais áreas do prédio e da propriedade conforme instruções do gerente de operações.

• Executar corretamente os procedimentos de Bloqueio e Etiquetagem (Lockout Tagout) e manter atenção constante à segurança.

• Utilizar ferramentas elétricas e manuais para realizar diversas tarefas, incluindo reparo de máquinas, montagem de tubulação, manutenção elétrica e eletrônica.

• Operar empilhadeiras, carrinhos e outros equipamentos básicos de carga e descarga, quando necessário.

• Fazer a lubrificação, engraxamento e abastecimento dos equipamentos conforme necessário.

• Completar procedimentos rotineiros de manutenção preventiva conforme estabelecido no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoiar programas de redução de custos e controle de despesas, priorizando consertar ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdícios de materiais e suprimentos, e utilizando corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos.

CONHECIMENTOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES BÁSICAS:

• Capacidade comprovada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para identificar e corrigir problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz.

• Habilidade para operar equipamentos básicos de escritório como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de postagem e sistemas telefônicos multilinha.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.

EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Deve ser capaz de ficar em pé, caminhar e/ou sentar por longos períodos, além de dobrar-se, agachar, subir escadas, alcançar, carregar objetos e rastejar em áreas confinadas.

• Deve ter capacidade para trabalhar em áreas internas e externas em todas as condições climáticas (chuva, neve, calor, granizo, vento e gelo).

• Deve ser capaz de empurrar, puxar, levantar, carregar ou manusear pesos de até 11 kg sozinho e até 23 kg com ajuda.

• Deve ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo sobreaviso durante noites, fins de semana e feriados.

title: Loyalty and Subscription Strategies Manager
description:
Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please upload an English version of your resume.

About the Position

We are looking for a strategic and creative professional to lead our Gamification & Subscription Strategies efforts. This role focuses on building innovative mechanisms such as missions, streaks, and loyalty programs that drive user engagement, as well as developing subscription-based models that strengthen recurrence and create long-term value. You will design, test, and scale programs that make our platform fun, sticky, and habit-forming, positioning us to compete head-to-head with established loyalty schemes in the market.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement gamification strategies (progress bars, streaks, missions, rewards) that increase frequency and stickiness across user segments.
  • Develop and refine subscription models and loyalty programs that maximize user retention and LTV, while differentiating from competitor offerings.
  • Collaborate with CRM, Growth, and Product teams to integrate gamification mechanics into the user journey and app experience.
  • Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to evaluate the impact of gamified features and subscription perks on user behavior.
  • Monitor and analyze engagement metrics, progression funnel, and churn patterns to optimize program design and efficiency.
  • Partner with Data and Finance teams to build business cases for gamification and subscription initiatives, measuring ROI and long-term sustainability.
  • Explore partnerships with restaurants, brands, and third parties to enrich the subscription and gamification ecosystem.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitor strategies, ensuring our programs are locally relevant, innovative, and scalable.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in business, economics, engineering, or related fields.
  • Robust experience in user operations, loyalty, CRM, or product growth strategy in digital platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to extract insights and validate impact.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and scaling gamification or subscription programs.
  • Familiarity with user segmentation, behavioral psychology, and habit-forming product design.
  • Background in e-commerce, O2O, food delivery, or subscription-based businesses preferred.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Creative, data-driven, and results-oriented, with the ability to balance user delight with business impact.

We hope to see you soon ;)

#Keeta #EatBetter #Live Better

CNH Industrial is a world-class equipment and services company dedicated to advancing the noble work of agriculture and construction workers. Driven by our shared purpose of Breaking New Ground, we are passionate about bringing Innovation, Sustainability, and Productivity to all that we do. As a truly global company, CNH Industrial's 37,000+ employees form part of a diverse and inclusive workplace, focused on empowering customers to grow, and build, a better world through our core brands: Case IH, STEYR, New Holland Agriculture, CASE, and New Holland Construction.

In Precision Technology, we make iron smarter. Our team members deliver innovative solutions helping our customers to be more productive, save time, lower costs, and to operate sustainably. From vehicle displays, application controls, steering solutions, digital services, and telematics, to fully autonomous driverless technology, we develop solutions that solve challenges for customers around the world.

#GrowACareer.

#BuildAFuture.

Atividades Inbound

  • Gestão de provisões (accruals) de frete inbound, assegurando correto reconhecimento contábil e compliance com auditoria.
  • Controle de custos de transporte inbound (rodoviário, marítimo, aéreo e serviços logísticos)
  • Gestão financeira do WMF Brasil, incluindo controle de despesas logísticas, alocação por centro de lucro e acompanhamento das movimentações entre plantas e o 3PL.
  • Controle e atualização de custos std (standard cost) de transporte inbound, garantindo que cada item consumido tenha o frete std corretamente atrelado e que as variações (real vs. std) sejam explicadas e reportadas.

  • Elaboração de relatórios para liderança (MOR, Forecast Reviews, CFO updates), traduzindo os impactos logísticos em indicadores financeiros claros.
  • Interface com áreas globais e locais (Operações, Contratos, Fiscal/Tax, Tesouraria e Engenharia) para garantir aderência a normas contábeis, regulatórias e compliance (incluindo SOX).
  • Análise de impactos de tarifas, impostos e regulações aduaneiras (Recof, Ex-Tarifário, alterações de Incoterm), consolidando ganhos e perdas no resultado.
  • Suporte em BID/RFQ de transportadoras, avaliando cenários financeiros, savings potenciais e impactos no budget/forecast.
  • Monitoramento de KPIs financeiros logísticos, como custo por tonelada/km, saturação de caminhões, waiting hours e demurrage, consolidando dashboards para decisão.

Requisitos:

Superior completo.

Experiência em finanças e controladoria, com sólidos conhecimentos contábeis.

Experiência com melhoria de processos e implementação de melhores práticas.

Experiência em suporte a auditorias e garantia de conformidade com a SOX e controles internos.

Experiência em ambientes multinacionais, com relatórios e colaboração entre equipes globais.

Experiência prática com análise financeira, previsão e planejamento estratégico (FP&A).

Experiência prévia com estruturas de custos e impactos financeiros de transporte/logística de entrada (preferencial).

You will own the entire sales cycle for a defined territory or portfolio, directly contributing to our company's market leadership and revenue targets.

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master's visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You'll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.

  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience: 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise:
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills:
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement:
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.

Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About the Company

Diib is a company based out of Salt Lake City, Utah. Diib's mission is to make internet marketing clearer for individuals who don't know anything about it. Diib helps small and medium businesses to find new ways to grow with Actionable Analytics, Industry-Based Ranking, and Custom Learning Tracks. 250k websites use Diib. The product is AI for SEO and other internet marketing aspects.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software, ensuring robust system performance, and driving automation best practices. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.
  • Implement and manage test data and environments to ensure reliable and repeatable test execution.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define quality benchmarks and ensure test coverage for all requirements.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

  • Execute detailed automated and manual tests across multiple platforms and devices to validate functionality, usability, and performance.
  • Ensure that systems meet reliability, scalability, and availability expectations, especially in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions, particularly Amazon Redshift.
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms, such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).

What We Offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems, Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583), ATM/POS terminal driving, and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform.
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules, authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution.
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic.
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing, card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management.

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet), cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git, and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

Tudo isso torna possível a união entre a busca por resultados e o engajamento dos colaboradores com a sustentabilidade.

E não poderíamos deixar de falar que nós, do Daycoval, consideramos todos os talentos, independentemente de etnia, religião, cor, sexo, idade, condição de deficiência, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, ou qualquer outro motivo que caracterize discriminação pela legislação local.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a versatile, out-of-the-box Sales Development Rep in Brazil. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR is someone who loves cold calling, has CRM experience, carries a hunter mentality, and loves to be coached on advanced selling tactics.

The SDR should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and the ability to showcase our offerings in a compelling way.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.

Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There's always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That's where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!

The Perfect Candidate Is Able To

  • Use extensive knowledge and consumer research to demonstrate how our solutions meet customer needs, effectively representing the company's products and services
  • Nurture cold and warm prospects and uncover new sales opportunities to generate leads and establish relationships
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects, actively involving sales executives in the next steps
  • Identify and implement effective strategies to improve the company's lead funnel

Responsibilities Include

  • Utilizing HubSpot, cold calls, and email to generate sales opportunities
  • Identifying prospect needs and recommending suitable products or services
  • Building trusted, long-term relationships with prospects to qualify leads for sales
  • Actively seeking new business opportunities in the market
  • Arranging meetings or calls between (prospective) customers and sales executives
  • Providing weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on results to the sales manager

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Two or more years of sales experience with a track record of exceeding lead targets
  • Strong communication skills via phone and email
  • Proven, creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills
  • Strong desire and ability to move up within a sales organization
  • Loves being coached
  • Is available to work 8:30 am–5 pm ET

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience as a sales development representative, with a track record of achieving sales quotas
  • Proficiency with HubSpot or other CRM software
  • Experienced cold caller with power dialer experience
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) or at least five years of relevant work experience

title: Wholesale Account Director
description:
About GTT:

GTT is a leading networking and security-as-a-service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD-WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by professional services and exceptional sales and support teams worldwide. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together. Learn more at

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategies to penetrate Tier 1/2 carriers & ISPs
  • Sell GTT's international network services, including Global WAN, Ethernet, Direct Internet Access, IP Transit, SD-WAN, and MPLS.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with wholesale partners and decision-making units with significant international footprints.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities from a standing start and revive dormant accounts.
  • Present GTT's value proposition to prospects and customers through compelling proposals and presentations.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through development to close, ensuring timely execution and deal completion.
  • Collaborate with marketing and internal teams to maximize prospecting initiatives and accelerate pipeline growth.
  • Candidates must speak, English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Required Experience/Qualifications:

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the LATAM wholesale carrier market, including the commercial landscape, pricing dynamics, and cross-border connectivity trends. Knowledge of major Tier 1 carriers and regional operators—such as Claro, Telefónica, América Móvil, and Millicom—is essential to identify opportunities and negotiate effectively. This expertise will enable the candidate to position GTT's global network solutions competitively and drive strategic growth in the region.

  • 5–10+ years of experience in wholesale or reseller sales within the telecom or networking industry.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing deals with Tier 1 carriers, ISPs, and channel partners.
  • Strong knowledge of global WAN services, Ethernet, DIA, IP Transit, and related technologies.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as SPIN, Miller Heiman, or similar.
  • Ability to engage confidently with technical topics and articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Experience selling SD-WAN and security solutions.
  • Established network of contacts within the carrier and reseller ecosystem.

Core Competencies:

  • Negotiating
  • Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Networking
  • Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive.
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations
  • Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling
  • Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer need.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing)
  • Knowledge of customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting customer value creation at every level. Builds relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.

EEO Statement:

GTT provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, GTT complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Unbounce

title: Principal Consultant - SOC Transformation and XSIAM Deployment
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.
Your Impact
  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel
Additional Information
Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn't stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You'll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won't wait for them to be raised, you'll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.
Our Commitment
We're problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: HR Business Partner (individual contributor position)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for your curiosity

We're driven by ambition and guided by a bold vision for the years ahead. As we scale our profitable ecosystem of tools and services, we're seeking a dedicated and adaptable HR Business Partner – Brazil (individual contributor position) to help us bring our People strategy to life and support our teams on the ground.

In this position, you will report directly to the Director of People and work closely with leaders and employees to ensure that People processes run efficiently and consistently. This is an individual contributor role with a strong execution component — combining hands-on delivery with collaboration and influence across regional and global teams.

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers — from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, and department stores to fashion brands — across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, and Colombia.

We have three key products:

  • Flexifleet – Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.
  • Fulfillment Optimizer – Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing, and delivery.
  • Consumer Connect – AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability.

Backed by over USD 70 million in venture capital, we've delivered consistent growth and completed 100+ million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across Latin America — and this is just the beginning.

Who you are

You are a hands-on HR professional who enjoys being close to the business and the people. You combine empathy, structure, and a strong sense of ownership to deliver high-quality results.

You thrive in dynamic environments, balancing operational priorities with thoughtful, people-centered solutions. You're someone who makes things happen while building trust and collaboration across teams.

What you will do

  • Partner with business leaders and employees across Brazil to provide day-to-day support on key HR processes — from onboarding and employee relations to development and engagement.
  • Deliver a best-in-class onboarding experience.
  • Implement surveys, analyze data, and develop action plans to close gaps.
  • Manage Rewards and Incentives: leverage current compensation and incentive plans, as well as benchmarking against other companies and industries to ensure our schemes are fit for the future.
  • Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
  • Protect the organization's value by keeping information confidential.
  • Comply with local legal requirements by studying existing and new legislation; enforcing adherence to requirements; advising management on needed actions.
  • Participate in developing department goals, objectives, and systems.
  • Handle employee relations counseling, outplacement counseling, and exit interviews.
  • Own the plan and logistics of internal events.
  • Implement and sustain People initiatives, ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
  • Manage HR operations and documentation with accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
  • Work closely with regional people partners to align priorities, localize global programs, and ensure effective implementation in Brazil.

The skills and experience you will bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields.
  • 4+ years of experience in HR, ideally as a Business Partner in fast-paced or tech environments.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian labor legislation and HR best practices.
  • Experience in employee relations, HR operations, and process implementation.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in helping teams succeed.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

description:

Missão da Área

A área de Planejamento Financeiro e Análise (FP&A) atua como parceira estratégica do negócio, apoiando decisões por meio de análises financeiras sólidas e visão integrada de performance.

Em um setor dinâmico como o de Energia, somos responsáveis por planejar, projetar e acompanhar resultados, assegurando eficiência no uso dos recursos e alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa.

Além de elaborar orçamentos, forecasts e análises de rentabilidade, o time também apoia diversas áreas da companhia, atuando como ponto central e oficial dos dados financeiros, promovendo consistência e integração nas informações.

O FP&A é ainda responsável pela divulgação dos resultados ao mercado, incluindo a preparação do Relatório da Administração, garantindo transparência e credibilidade nas comunicações financeiras.

Mais do que controlar números, a área transforma dados em insights que traduzem a estratégia em resultados concretos, fortalecendo a sustentabilidade e o crescimento de longo prazo da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão do orçamento de CAPEX (pelo sistema Project Oracle e por planilhas/dashboards) e OPEX (por planilhas/dashboards);
  • Elaboração de controles e indicadores para acompanhamento de metas corporativas;
  • Criação de visões gerenciais por unidade de negócio, com conciliação contábil;
  • Análise detalhada do resultado vs. orçado (DRE e balanço), explorando os drivers de negócio com as áreas de geração e portfólio de energia;
  • Utilização do sistema Oracle PBCS para projeções e simulações financeiras;
  • Criação e automação de planilhas, relatórios e análises, visando eficiência e padronização;
  • Suporte às áreas parceiras no acompanhamento do orçamento e execução;
  • Desenvolvimento de máscaras e templates de reports para uso interno e divulgação externa.

Requisitos Técnicos e Ferramentas

  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em controladoria/FP&A em ambientes dinâmicos e orientados a dados;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em contabilidade e modelagem financeira;
  • Alta capacidade analítica e visão integrada de negócios;

Soft Skills Desejadas

  • Raciocínio estruturado e pensamento analítico: capacidade de decompor problemas complexos em partes claras e solucionáveis;
  • Aprendizado rápido e curiosidade intelectual: disposição para entender novos temas e negócios com agilidade;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade: conforto em ambientes dinâmicos e com mudanças constantes de prioridades;

  • Senso de dono e proatividade: autonomia para agir e buscar soluções antes que os problemas apareçam;
  • Gestão da informação e atenção ao detalhe: organização e precisão no tratamento de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Comunicação analítica e storytelling financeiro: clareza para traduzir análises complexas em mensagens objetivas e acionáveis;
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua: foco em otimização de processos, inovação e geração de valor sustentável.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Ter trabalhado no controle de CAPEX de grandes projetos;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de planejamento (Hyperion, Oracle PBCS);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de ferramentas de data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks);

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team's value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer's needs.

This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti's Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti's tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti's tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A "whatever it takes" customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We're problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: CRM Engineer - Integration & Automation
description:
CRM Engineer – Integration & Automation (Contractor)

Schedule: 40 hours per week – Remote

About the Role

Our cliente is looking for a CRM Engineer to join our Integration & Automation team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable integrations and automation solutions across business systems.

This role requires a professional with solid hands-on engineering experience — someone who can go beyond configuration and actively build, integrate, and optimize workflows across multiple platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems (including NetSuite and marketing automation platforms).
  • Build automation solutions leveraging Workato, MuleSoft, and custom code (Node.js, JavaScript).
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance) to understand business processes and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop APIs and workflows that enhance data flow and system interoperability.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and ensure consistent system performance and scalability.
  • Follow best practices in source control, deployment, and DevOps methodologies for CRM and automation systems.

  • NetSuite (from an integration perspective).
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, OAuth, and SSO.
  • Experience with "drag-and-drop" style integration builders.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience developing or supporting Salesforce automation (Apex, Triggers, LWC).
  • Familiarity with Heroku, Python, or microservice architectures.
  • Exposure to DevOps, Git branching, and Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with Salesforce frameworks like CPQ, Experience Cloud, or Einstein.
  • Solid understanding of data flows, declarative automation vs. custom development, and integration best practices.

Ideal Profile

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proactive communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Focused on delivering scalable, reliable, and maintainable integration solutions.

Job Title: Compliance Sr Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights:

  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world's leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE!

Job Description

Senior Manager position to act as the primary Compliance Officer for Samsung's Latin America business, serving as a trusted advisor and compliance leader. This position will implement and oversee the compliance program at both regional and subsidiaries levels, ensuring adherence to all applicable laws and regulations of Latin America, including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Panama and Peru. This role requires the Compliance Officer to collaborate extensively with the broader Legal and Compliance team to uphold Samsung's global standards and will advise stakeholders on the compliance implications of business decisions.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Serve as the designated Compliance professional in accordance with local regulations.
  • Oversee and administer the compliance program for Samsung Latin America.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce compliance policies and procedures, ensuring ongoing adherence of all applicable regulations, such as labor, fair competition, anti-bribery, anti-corruptions, etc.
  • Conduct due diligences and maintain strong relationship with key stakeholders.
  • Ensure day-to-day compliance with periodic activities, such as internal audits, communication campaigns and trainings.
  • Identify, assess and mitigate legal and compliance risks specific to the Latin America business through effective controls and monitoring.
  • Lead and oversee ethics investigations into ethics and integrity incidents, utilizing investigative techniques and data analysis to detect irregularities.
  • Stay informed on regulatory developments in the Latin America region and assess impacts on compliance and business operations. Produce timely and accurate reports to Senior management and Global Office, maintaining compliance with all obligations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law required.
  • Prior experience at a multinational company and/or Law firms.
  • Specialization or Master's Degree in Compliance, Corporate Governance or related corporate areas is desirable.
  • Compliance certification (CCEP, CPC-A) will be considered as a plus.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
About the Brand We're a bold beauty brand redefining service, fun and results. With our unique DNA and iconic products, we create experiences that go beyond makeup — connecting people, services, and storytelling in every touchpoint.

Role Summary The Marketing Manager 360° sits at the intersection of all cross-functional teams driving the brand and product marketing strategy forward in Brazil. This person blends strategic thinking and creative execution, ensuring the brand remains innovative, disruptive, and locally relevant. You'll bring global campaigns to life in a uniquely Brazilian way, with a consumer-first mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and a passion for brand storytelling and results.

Key Responsibilities

Integrated / 360° Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the full 360° marketing strategy for Brazil, aligned with LATAM and global direction.
  • Bring to life the brand DNA through impactful and locally relevant campaigns, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (creative, digital, retail, PR, influencer, trade, and education) to deliver cohesive brand experiences.
  • Adapt global campaigns and craft localized initiatives based on strategic insights and consumer behavior.
  • Define KPIs and monitor performance to ensure ROI and continuous optimization.
  • Manage marketing budget efficiently and align investments with business priorities.

Brand Activations, Events & Partnerships

  • Ideate and lead brand activations, pop-ups, and in-store experiences that amplify engagement and conversion.
  • Collaborate with influencer and PR teams to develop creative and culturally relevant events, trips, and product send-outs that generate strong EMV and social buzz.
  • Build and manage brand partnerships that expand audience reach while maintaining aspirational image and consistency. This includes experience with negotiating partnership agreements.
  • Oversee the brand's visual merchandising expression across retail doors, ensuring high-quality, on-brand execution.
  • Partner with the Retail & Education teams to boost service awareness and service sales across stores.
  • Coordinate GWP programs, launch activations, and local communication campaigns with a consumer-centric mindset.
  • The ability to analyze ROI for each activation will be key to ensure the spend had a positive impact on retail sales.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Serve as the local bridge between global brand strategy and field execution.
  • Ensure flawless implementation across channels (in-store, online, influencer, social).
  • Lead project timelines, agency briefings, creative reviews, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply, and Trade Marketing to secure on-time delivery and smooth rollout.
  • Ensure effective communication and collaboration with sales and finance teams to align objectives and maximize results.
  • Report regularly to management on marketing KPIs, results, and insights.

Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of experience in Marketing or Brand Management within beauty, FMCG, or lifestyle industries.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian retail landscape and consumer behavior.
  • Creative and strategic thinker, with a proven ability to innovate within Global brand guidelines and create data-driven digital campaigns that boost brand awareness and sales.
  • Expertise in marketing strategy combined with strong financial acumen, including proven ability to prepare and manage budgets, analyze marketing spend, forecast sales, and develop data-driven strategies aligned with commercial objectives and measurable impact.
  • Excellent project management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across departments.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven.
  • MANDATORY Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint), Google Workspace, and ideally Asana or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Passion for beauty, trends, and building emotional consumer connections.
  • Experience working with global brands and adapting marketing strategies to local markets.

Success Metrics

  • Growth in brand awareness and preference above market trend.
  • Increase in service sales and store traffic.
  • Strong ROI on campaigns and activations.
  • Excellent cross-functional alignment and execution quality.
  • Elevated brand perception and consumer engagement.

Why Join Us We're not just selling beauty — we're creating moments of joy, confidence, and connection. If you're a marketer who blends creativity, curiosity, and commercial drive, and you want to make an impact in a dynamic, growing brand — this is your next challenge.
